name: Future Floodplain 2020s
description:
This dataset contains geospatial records describing future floodplain zones for the 2020s, with 4,484 sampled rows and 10 columns. Each row represents a mapped floodplain feature and includes a flood zone classification (AE, VE, or AO), a static base flood elevation value, and a modeled base flood elevation for the 0.2 percent annual chance event. Records also carry geometry measures such as shape length and area, a grid code, and several identifier fields (join count, target feature ID, record ID, and original feature ID). About three-quarters of rows have no flood zone label or elevation value, while the remaining rows are mostly classified as AE or VE zones.

The data supports flood risk assessment, land-use and urban planning, insurance and property analysis, climate adaptation planning, and GIS mapping of future flood exposure. The elevation and zone fields can be used to compare current and modeled flood heights, while the geometry and grid fields support spatial analysis and visualization.
